color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no twist. Light register: pageBackground #fcf7f1 (luminance 247.8). Warm ivory cream palette. Pure black body text for maximum contrast. Deep indigo-black hero background. Warm gray surface (#e8e3da) for card backgrounds.

type-system.twistDescription: Replaced cyberpunk HUD aesthetic (Orbitron/monospace) with warm calligraphic editorial style. Cormorant Garamond 400 italic h1 (90px) + Cormorant Garamond 600 h2 (60px) + EB Garamond 400 body (17px, 1.75 line-height) + Courier Prime 400 mono. Three Google Fonts CDN imports. Botanical editorial aesthetic.

motion-system.twistDescription: Organic Ink-Reveal Aesthetic: base 0.70-0.75s, organic cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1). Keyframes: ink-reveal (clip-path left-to-right wipe), ink-blot (scale+rotate organic expansion), ink-rise (gentle upward fade), parchment-fade (warm sepia dissolve). All utility classes included.

grid-system.twistDescription: Editorial/journal botanical grid: 12-column, 28px gutters, 1520px max-width. Utility classes: .journal-full (1/-1), .journal-feature (col 3/span 8), .journal-split (5fr/7fr with divider), .journal-narrow (col 4/span 6), .journal-aside (span 3), .journal-wide (col 2/span 10). Thin botanical rules via CSS variables.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Generous Botanical Margins: hero 112px vertical/48px horizontal, container 104px vertical/64px horizontal (wide book margins), section gap 40px, nav padding-block 18px, grid gap 40px. Everything breathes like a fine art book.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Organic ink-absorption interactions. All transitions 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1). Links: drawn-in underlines via background-gradient (0% → 100% backgroundSize). Cards: translateY(-2px) lift with shadow bloom. Active: scale(0.98) pressed-paper feel. Focus: 2px outline at 3px offset. Zero instant state changes.

nav-system.twistDescription: Minimal editorial nav with botanical warmth. Cormorant Garamond 0.8rem normal case (Check C PASS — Cormorant Garamond is the display font in assembled type system). Transparent → warm white on scroll. Thin rule draws in (opacity 0.2→0.6). No backdrop blur — paper warmth, not glass. 64px height.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Shifted from vaporwave neon dreamscape to botanical reverence. Concept: Seedkeep — a heritage seed library and botanical nursery. Design as living archive. Editorial/journal composition, hand-drawn botanical illustration, ink-reveal animations, ambient macro video. Three video placements: botanical-unfold-loop.mp4, hands-in-soil-loop.mp4, garden-cycle-loop.mp4.

A_colorContrast.notes: navText #000000 (brightness 0) vs navBackground transparent → pageBackground #fcf7f1 (brightness 248) — maximum contrast. bodyText #000000 vs pageBackground #fcf7f1 — maximum contrast.

B_motionInteractionCoherence.notes: Motion base 0.75s. Interaction hover transitions 0.55s. Ratio 1.36× — well under 5× threshold. Both use cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1) — organically unified.

C_navFontAvailability.notes: Nav typography fontFamily 'Cormorant Garamond', serif. Cormorant Garamond is the primary display/heading font in assembled type system (ds-font-family-display, ds-font-family-heading). Full availability confirmed.
